## What and why

Describe the problem and the smallest complete solution. Link an issue if applicable.

## Compatibility

Note Python API, Rust API, wire-format, or callback behavior changes.

## Validation

- [ ] Added focused regression tests where behavior changes
- [ ] Ran `make check`
- [ ] Checked Java/Go interoperability if wire behavior changes
- [ ] Updated README/stubs/changelog when applicable

For performance changes, include reproducible before/after workloads and versions.
For suspected vulnerabilities, use the private reporting route in SECURITY.md.
